data.name: Secret Knowledge
data.description: You discover a series of patterns previously outside your perception.  You learn two powers of 6th level or lower from the cryptic or psion/wilder power list.  In addition, your Intelligence modifier is treated as 4 higher when dtermining your power points per day.
